behavior: GW-58 terminates documentation recursion when drift is zero and routes directly to terminal receipt refresh.
GW-59/GW-60/GW-61/GW-63 emit EffectPlans matching the exact schemas of existing GitHub lifecycle tools; GW-60 reuses github_create_commit for bounded multi-file documentation reconciliation.
A documentation-only merge/autodeploy may become the final runtime SHA; GW-65 requires CURRENT, fully aligned Live State on that exact SHA before terminal continuation.

GW-68 implements the NO_FALSE_DONE predicate over one coherent evidence matrix: Task VERIFYING and owner session, Bootstrap Receipt/stateVersion, final CI, final deploy job, review, locks, Live State, documentation state, head SHA and runtime revision.
Own valid locks may remain during GW-68, but any foreign conflicting lock blocks terminal verification.

GW-69 plans DONE only from a successful GW-68 proof bound to the same task/session/receipt/state/head/runtime. The proof digest is retained in the planner result/recovery anchor without adding unsupported fields to mcp_transition_governed_task.

Closure ordering is terminal verification -> DONE -> checkpoint -> lock release -> session close -> queue reconciliation. Lock release is not conditioned on task success once a terminal checkpoint exists.
Candidate evaluation and planning are side-effect free: authorizationInferred=false and mutationPerformed=false.
